\begin{example} \end{example}[The Euclidean Group]

1. ch7:7.32The Euclidean group is $\mathrm E(n)=\mathbb R^n\rtimes \mathrm O(n)$ with \[ (b,A)(b',A')=(b+Ab',AA'),\qquad (b,A)\cdot x=b+Ax. \] This action preserves lines, distances, and angles. \end{example}
